August 25, 2026


# Helping Marine Customers Improve Efficiency and Reliability: Garrett at SMM Hamburg


Garrett will showcase its advanced marine turbocharging solutions at **SMM Hamburg** 2026, one of the maritime industry’s leading international trade fairs, taking place **September 1-4, 2026, in Germany.** At the event, Garrett will highlight its MEG turbocharger platform, designed to help marine propulsion and power-generation operators achieve higher engine efficiency, faster response, dependable performance and lifecycle value in demanding operating environments.


Under the theme “GARRETT MEG: EFFICIENT. DURABLE. PEACE OF MIND INCLUDED.”, the company will demonstrate how advanced turbocharging technology helps vessel owners, engine manufacturers and power-generation operators address growing demands for operational efficiency, fuel flexibility and long-term performance.


As the marine industry continues to navigate evolving regulatory requirements, increasing efficiency targets and changing fuel strategies, customers need solutions that deliver both performance and reliability. **Built to support a broad range of applications and fuels** , including heavy fuel oil (HFO), diesel, natural gas and landfill gas, Garrett’s MEG platform enables customers to optimize performance while reducing total cost of ownership.


Designed for both **propulsion and power-generation applications** , the MEG turbochargers deliver improved engine efficiency across a wide operating range while maintaining rapid transient response for changing loads and critical power requirements. Combined with Garrett’s global aftermarket network, including service support, spare parts availability and retrofit solutions, MEG turbochargers help customers maximize uptime, improve performance and enhance operational confidence.


Garrett’s presence at SMM Hamburg also reflects the company’s continued expansion into industrial sectors such as marine and power generation. Drawing on more than **70 years of turbocharging expertise** and leadership in high-speed technologies, Garrett develops differentiated solutions that help customers improve fuel and energy efficiency, enhance performance and reduce emissions across a wide range of applications.


Visitors to SMM Hamburg 2026 are invited to explore Garrett’s latest marine turbocharging innovations and connect with the company’s engineering and commercial teams to discuss application-specific requirements. Through its participation, Garrett reaffirms its commitment to delivering innovative, efficient, and durable solutions that help customers navigate the evolving demands of marine and power-generation markets.
